meta.title: LocalGrow | Aapka Business. Online Strong. — Mohali & Tricity
meta.description: LocalGrow aapke local business (salon, clinic, restaurant, coaching, shop) ke liye professional website, Google presence aur WhatsApp enquiries setup karta hai. Transparent pricing, no hidden costs.

hero.title: Aapka Business. Online Strong.
hero.subtitle: LocalGrow aapke business ki complete online presence setup karta hai — professional website, Google presence, WhatsApp enquiries aur customer-friendly online experience.

benefits.title: Aapko kya milega?
benefits.subtitle: Technical tension humari, customers aapke. Bina kisi confusion ke ye 6 zaroori fayde:
benefits.card1Desc: Customer ko aapka business professional aur bharosemand dikhega.
benefits.card2Desc: Aas-paas ke customers ko aapko Google par dhoondhna bilkul easy hoga.
benefits.card3Desc: Interested customer ek click mein direct aapke WhatsApp par aayega.
benefits.card4Desc: One-tap direct calling aur Google Maps par dukan ki exact location.
benefits.card5Desc: Smartphone par aapki website super fast aur crystal clear chalegi.
benefits.card6Desc: Aapko hosting, domain ya code samajhne ki bilkul zarurat nahi.

problemSolution.title: Aaj ka Business vs LocalGrow ke Baad
problemSolution.subtitle: Aapke competitor online customers le ja rahe hain kyunki unka setup ready hai. LocalGrow aapko aage laata hai.
problemSolution.p1: Website nahi hai — customer ko trust nahi hota
problemSolution.p2: Google profile incomplete ya search mein aati hi nahi
problemSolution.p3: Customer ko services, photos ya rate list nahi milti
problemSolution.p4: WhatsApp ya phone par direct contact karna difficult hai
problemSolution.p5: Aas-paas ka competitor online better dikhta hai aur customer le jata hai
problemSolution.s1: Modern professional website jo har phone par smooth chalti hai
problemSolution.s2: Complete Google profile jisse local customer turant contact kare
problemSolution.s3: Clear services list, price overview aur high-quality photo gallery
problemSolution.s4: Direct WhatsApp & instant call buttons har jagah available
problemSolution.s5: Area mein aapka business modern, active aur sabse trustworthy lagega

howItWorks.title: Kaam kaise hota hai?
howItWorks.subtitle: Bilkul straightforward 5 steps. Koi complicated paperwork ya technical meetings nahi.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Apne business ka naam, services, location, photos aur contact details share karein.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Aapki website design, Google presence setup aur WhatsApp flow ready karte hain.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Live demo check karein aur jo bhi badlav ya text change karwana ho batayein.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Aapka apna custom business domain connect karke website internet par live.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Google Search → Website → WhatsApp/Call → Direct Customer Enquiry!

services.title: Hum aapke business ke liye kya karte hain?
services.subtitle: Har ek service ka focus sirf ek hai: local customer ko aapke business par bharosa dilana aur enquiry lana.
services.s1Desc: Fast loading, clean design jo phone aur computer dono par professional lage.
services.s2Desc: Google Maps aur search results par aapke business ki right details aur timing setup.
services.s3Desc: One-click WhatsApp chat button taaki customer bina number save kiye msg bhej sake.
services.s4Desc: Direct click-to-call button — customer screen par tap karke seedha aapko call kare.
services.s5Desc: Exact location pinpoint taaki customer bina rasta bhatke aapki shop tak pahuche.
services.s6Desc: Happy customers se 5-star Google reviews lene ka simple aur practical tarika.
services.s7Desc: Aapke kaam, shop, clinic ya salon ki clean aur attractive photos ka showcase.
services.s8Desc: Aap kya kaam karte hain aur rates kya hain, sab customer ke liye crystal clear.
services.s9Desc: Simple 30-second form jisse customer apni requirement turant submit kar sake.
services.s10Desc: Aapke sheher aur area ke mutabiq keywords taaki local log aapko asaani se dhoondhein.

customerJourney.title: Customer aap tak kaise pahunchta hai?
customerJourney.subtitle: Dekhiye kaise ek normal phone user aapka paying customer ban jata hai:
customerJourney.j1Desc: Customer phone par search karta hai: 'Best salon near me' ya 'Clinic in Mohali'.
customerJourney.j2Desc: Google par aapka business, rating aur link prominently samne aata hai.
customerJourney.j3Desc: Fast speed mein aapki clean aur professional website open hoti hai.
customerJourney.j4Desc: Customer dekhta hai aap kya service dete hain aur kitna badiya kaam hai.
customerJourney.j5Desc: Google reviews aur transparent details dekh kar customer decide kar leta hai.
customerJourney.j6Desc: Ek tap karke customer direct WhatsApp message ya phone call karta hai.
customerJourney.j7Desc: Booking confirm hoti hai aur wo aapki shop/clinic par visit karta hai.

whyUs.title: Humare saath kaam kyun karein?
whyUs.subtitle: Kyunki hum typical IT company ya agency nahi hain jo baatein ghumaaye.
whyUs.w1Desc: Technical language nahi. Hosting, server, DNS ki baatein hum par chhod dein.
whyUs.w2Desc: Jo price bataya gaya hai, wahi rahega. Koi chhupe hue rules nahi.
whyUs.w3Desc: Domain, hosting, setup pehle se clear likha hua hai. Bad mein koi surprise nahi.
whyUs.w4Desc: Sirf decorative website nahi banate, aisi website banate hain jisse customers connect karein.
whyUs.w5Desc: Chhote aur local business ke budget, ground reality aur challenges ko samajhte hain.
whyUs.w6Desc: Koi ticket system ya automated bot nahi. Phone ya WhatsApp par seedha humse baat karein.

pricing.title: Transparent Plans. No Hidden Costs.
pricing.subtitle: Koi 'Call for pricing' ka jhanjhat nahi. Har plan mein kya milega, samne likha hai:
pricing.plan1F3: Super Fast Cloud Hosting — 1 Year Included
pricing.plan2F1: 4–5 Pages Professional Website (Home, About, Services, Gallery, Contact)
pricing.plan2F10: Detailed Local SEO for your City & Services
pricing.plan3F2: Monthly Small Content, Price & Photo Updates

transparency.title: Hum kuch chhupate nahi.
transparency.subtitle: Aksar agencies domain apne naam par rakh leti hain ya renewal par manmaane paise maangti hain. Humare yahan aaisa kuch nahi:
transparency.t1Desc: Domain aapke business ke naam par register hota hai. Aap hi uske asli maalik hain.
transparency.t2Desc: Pehle saal ka hosting charge plan mein already included hai. Alag se koi bill nahi.
transparency.t3Desc: 1 saal ke baad sirf normal third-party domain & hosting renewal charges lagte hain (~₹2,500 - ₹3,500/yr).
transparency.t4Desc: Agar aap package se alag koi extra feature chahte hain, uska price kaam shuru hone se pehle bataya jayega.
transparency.t5Desc: Hum 'Google par #1 ki guarantee' ya 'ek hafte mein lakhon leads' ka jhootha wada nahi karte. Hum solid foundation banate hain.
transparency.y1Desc: Website + Domain + Hosting + Setup complete ready.
transparency.y2Desc: Normal domain & server renewal. Koi hidden setup fee nahi.
transparency.y3Desc: Website uninterrupted chalti rahegi aur business grow karta rahega.

trustPromise.title: Humara Promise
trustPromise.p1Desc: Jo kaam aapke business ke liye zaruri hai, wahi suggest karenge. Faltu kharche nahi karwayenge.
trustPromise.p2Desc: Kaam shuru hone se pehle poori transparency. Beech mein achanak naye charges nahi aayenge.
trustPromise.p3Desc: Aapka domain aur data hamesha aapke paas rahega. Hum kisi business ko trap nahi karte.
trustPromise.p4Desc: Over-promising nahi. Professional online presence aur honest local guidance.
